decisions.reason: The coolant pressure booster extends the firm's core coolant management line and has stayed on the website, so the investment and visible commitment favour keeping it.

The cleaning centrifuge fits the firm's sustainability and coolant management direction and remains visibly marketed, so dropping it would write off engineering investment the firm has publicly backed.
Scraper belt chip conveyors are central to the firm's established chip conveying business and remain listed, giving little reason to withdraw them.
Hinged belt chip conveyors are a core, heavily invested part of the conveyor portfolio and are still on the website, so the firm will persist with them.
